deliveryTypes._purpose: UI checkbox ↔ swift Dispatcher API mapping. The single source of truth for app.js DELIVERY_MAP (next PR will make app.js consume this).
deliveryTypes._consumer_contract: When a checkbox.id is checked, union its `services` into the request body `services[]` and its `serviceTypes` into `serviceTypes[]`. Empty `serviceTypes` array means 'no serviceType narrowing for this delivery type'.

items.verification_note: Confirmed by combining enum probe with UI screenshot cross-check after the SAME_DAY_DELIVERY mis-mapping was caught (notes/api_endpoints.md 'What we wasted time on / Using SAME_DAY_DELIVERY for Spark Shop & Deliver'). May warrant re-verification when 'Customer returns' is mapped.

deliveryTypes._retired_note: Express Delivery and Scheduled Grocery were removed from the UI and from the request on 2026-08-29 at the analyst's request. Their mappings are kept below rather than deleted: the confidence levels and verification notes are research, and re-deriving them would mean repeating the enum probing. Restoring one is a matter of moving its object back into `items`.

retired.verification_note: Hypothesis: scheduled/slotted grocery delivery maps to SCHEDULED_DELIVERY and SAME_DAY_DELIVERY_WITH_SLOTS serviceTypes. Not yet verified via enum probe.

tripDisplayStatuses.consumer_note: app.js:385 filters viable candidates to displayTripStatus=='completed' for fraud investigation (not in_progress or unassigned).

watchlist._purpose: Driver-watchlist configuration. Consumed by modules/sparkfraud/service.js::pollWatchlist on every chrome.alarms tick. When a watched driver's displayTripStatus transitions into one of active_statuses, the service fires a desktop notification + auto-fetches order item details.
watchlist._consumer_contract: Edit active_statuses to tune which transitions fire alerts without code changes. Edit poll_interval_minutes to slow down / speed up the cadence (min 1 in production builds per chrome.alarms.create constraints).

transitStatuses.source: Dispatcher response transitStatus field (notes/tools/dispatcher_mfe.md:113); ON_TIME observed in sample, DELAYED referenced in app.js:416. Other possible values not yet enumerated.

carriers.source: swift LMDE_CARRIER_MASTER config response (notes/tools/dispatcher_mfe.md:167-169). Note says 'etc.' — list is observed but not asserted exhaustive.

owner_taxonomy._note: Per LMDE_CARRIER_MASTER metadata each carrier has an `owner` field with one of these values.

lineStatuses._note: OMS provider-oms/orders row.lineStatus field. 'cancelled' (case-insensitive) is the only value app.js currently special-cases (strikethrough render).
lineStatuses.source: app.js:141,361,503 string match on lineStatus.toLowerCase() === 'cancelled'. Other live values not enumerated.

taskEventStatuses._note: Order taskEvents[].eventStatus values. Used by viability heuristic (app.js:tripInStoreWindow).
taskEventStatuses.source: app.js:320-325 only. NOT documented in notes/api_endpoints.md or notes/tools/dispatcher_mfe.md.
taskEventStatuses.drift_risk: HIGH — heuristic core depends on these names; if Walmart renames either, viability filter silently returns viable=false for all trips.
